q: A European pump maker wants carbon data for castings from our Belagavi foundry. What do we give?
title: Belagavi foundry castings for export buyers
short: A product footprint per kg of casting: your melting energy, coke or electricity, sand and binders, and the metal charge, divided by good castings. Iron castings are mostly outside CBAM, so this is a buyer request, not a legal filing, but the buyer will use it in its own declarations.
audience: Ferrous and non-ferrous foundries in Belagavi exporting to Europe

ul: Pig iron, scrap and ferro-alloys charged, with factors.
Fettling, machining and heat treatment, if you do them.

p: Cast iron articles under heading 7325 are not in Annex I. Steel castings and some semi-finished forms can be. Check the CN code on your invoice.
Give the figure per kg and per part, state cradle to gate, and say which inputs are measured and which use averages.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel, electricity and purchase documents into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its source.
